name: Progress M-28
about: Progress M-28 (1995-036A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1995 Jul 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1995 Jul 27), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
